selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from node-local storage
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the package and index creation, enabled service, active listener, HTTP 200 response, and served package metadata.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: Shows both Ubuntu mirrors resolving to unreachable loopback endpoints, direct remote connection failures, successful local index retrieval, and installation of version 1.0.0 from http://10.100.103.10:8080.
Shows normal Ubuntu mirror access restored with HTTP 200 while the local repository remained reachable.

Baseline boot ID was 267e568a-ef2b-4189-9a7f-50a72b044473; reboot acknowledgement was captured; post-restart boot ID changed to 00df8ea4-ac84-4d71-b9fd-4e3e7300cada. The system returned to running state, the repository service was active and enabled, HTTP returned 200, repository checksums matched, and the installed package payload executed successfully.

set -eu
sudo sh -c "cat > /etc/systemd/system/local-apt-repo.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Node-local APT package repository
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]

ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /srv/local-apt

User=nobody
Group=nogroup

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
